answer.value: RahXephon jumps to the front of the pack (around 1971 popularity points), with One Piece Fan Letter and Juuou Mujin no Fafnir close behind in the same thousand-plus tier. The filter basically clears the clutter of niche OVAs so the blockbuster-style titles stand out as a clear top tier.

key_insights: RahXephon leads the post-filter ranking by a modest margin.
A handful of titles cluster near the top, while the rest trail off below.

reasoning.reasoning: Drops the low-volume titles so the comparison focuses on mainstream hits.
Descending sort surfaces the strongest popularity first.
